📑 Quick Jump: 1. Overview • 2. Key Details • 3. Closing Notes

Despite Robert Pattinson’s massive-screen career and Suki Waterhouse’s supermodel status, the public doesn’t know much about their relationship. Both of these Brits prefer to keep their private lives out of the public sphere. As their romance continues past the five-year mark and the couple settles into parenthood, here’s a rundown of their secretive story.

According to recent reports, pattinson and Waterhouse were first linked on July 30 when E! obtained photos of the pair kissing in the streets of London. Per the outlet’s report, the two saw a 9 P.M. showing of Mamma Mia! Here We Go Again at Electric Cinema in Notting Hill. They then walked across the street for drinks at SoHo House until 1 A.M.An eyewitness remarked the couple was open with their affection. “Along the way, they were very close and cuddled and kissed many times,” the source told E! News. “Robert was very affectionate to her and had his arm around her the whole way and Suki reciprocated by holding his hand and kissing it. They were very loved up and close. Robert stroked Suki’s hair and gave her another loving kiss.”.

Sources indicate that an E! source said the pair was only “casually dating.” Since Pattinson had only recently ended a three-year relationship, “he isn’t looking for anything serious right now.”.

According to recent reports, the insider did express that the two “are definitely into each other” and are dating while Pattinson is in London filming The King. “Rob likes to have fun when he has breaks in-between filming and him and Suki have a great time together,” the source added.

Recent findings suggest that laineyGossip disputed breakup rumors that surfaced at the time, sharing that Pattinson had FaceTimed Waterhouse walking home from a London pub in August. Per the outlet’s report, the couple was spotted at Miguel’s concert in Los Angeles.

They each also attended the Toronto International Film Festival for their own projects that month. Pattinson was promoting High Life while Waterhouse walked the carpet for Assassination Nation.

The couple was photographed exiting London club Chiltern Firehouse at 2:15 A.M., seemingly confirming they were still together.

It has been revealed that photos surfaced of the couple leaving a Christmas party on London’s Regent Street. Waterhouse and Pattinson stayed at the party until the early morning hours.

Waterhouse and Pattinson spent her 27th birthday together, photographed leaving her party. A couple weeks later, People ran photos of them holding hands after a run in London.

Pattinson made his first public comments about his relationship with Waterhouse.

The Sunday Times asked Pattinson about Waterhouse, and he responded by asking, “Do I have to [talk about her]?” Then he went into more detail about why he’s so private about his personal life:.

“If you let people in, it devalues what love is. If a stranger on the street asked you about your relationship, you’d think it extremely rude. If you put up a wall it ends up better. I can’t understand how someone can walk down the street holding hands, and it’s the same as when I do it and a hundred people are taking your photo. The line between when you’re performing and when you’re not will eventually get washed away, and you’ll go completely mad.”.

It has been revealed that however, he did tell the outlet that breakups with Kristen Stewart and FKA Twigs didn’t disillusion him to romance with a celebrity. “They were pretty long relationships, not like three months.”.

Recent findings suggest that when it came time for Pattinson’s 33rd birthday, he and Waterhouse were photographed at Chateau Marmont. Pattinson’s friend Tom Sturridge was also in attendance for the celebrations, per People.

During a June interview with Grazia, the reporter noted that Waterhouse FaceTimed Pattinson during a photo shoot break.

E! published a picture of Pattinson and Waterhouse strolling through London as they marked one year of dating.

In early September, photographer Sofia Malamute shared a photo of the couple cuddled together, captioned, “Ibiza, 2019.”.

After several months of staying out of the public eye, Waterhouse and Pattinson confirmed their relationship was still going strong. The pair was seen leaving Waterhouse’s 27th birthday party in London on January 12, per LaineyGossip.

They celebrated her birthday at London’s Casa Cruz, and attendees included Liv Tyler, Georgia May Jagger, Cara Delevingne, and Ashley Benson.

Pattinson essentially confirmed that he was quarantining with Waterhouse during an interview for GQ’s June cover. According to the article, Pattinson had been sequestered “with his girlfriend” in the London apartment “the Batman folks rented for him” while production on the film was paused.

The couple signaled they were still going strong, two years into their relationship, with a pair of public outings. On July 21, Pattinson and Waterhouse were photographed walking arm-in-arm around London’s Notting Hill.

Industry observers note that A source spoke to E! about the sighting, telling the outlet, “They weren’t recognized by anyone and they seemed to be in their own little world as they took a long stroll around the village chatting intently, pointing at properties and laughing together before they arrived at the club. In the photo, the couple sat on a London park bench with coffees, kissing while their masks were pulled down to their chins.

Sources indicate that pattinson’s recovery apparently only strengthened his relationship. A source told E! that “Rob and Suki have definitely discussed getting engaged but are in no rush. Suki is not pressuring him, and they are both very committed to each other.”.

Sources indicate that the insider confirmed the couple’s romance is “stronger than ever” after quarantine. “They love being low-key together and have very similar interests,” the source added. “They are truly inseparable and in love.”.

After months out of the limelight, Waterhouse made headlines when she posted a selfie of herself on April 15. Eagle-eyed fans noticed that a photo of her kissing Pattinson was visible in the background.

Recent findings suggest that on April 19, Pattinson and Waterhouse were photographed out in London for the first time in 2021. The two held hands while walking in Notting Hill. Both dressed casually, wearing shorts and hoodies. It served as a rare public signal that a year into quarantine, the couple’s relationship remained strong.

Ahead of the holidays, Waterhouse and Pattinson were photographed on December 8 holding hands in Newly introduced York City on a winter day date. Pattinson wore a monochrome blue look consisting of a hooded puffer jacket with matching blue pants. Waterhouse chose earth tones, stepping out in a brown Carhartt hat, rose-colored wool coat, and a black Dior cashmere shawl. It was their first time being photographed out together in months.

Pattinson opened up a little about his life with Waterhouse in two interviews during his The Batman press tour.

To GQ, he spoke about her impact on his decision-making—and how she trolled him by talking with a repairman at their place about DC Comics.

Pattinson stated Waterhouse was the reason why he changed the location for his GQ interview from the London Zoo to Holland Park. “I was talking to my girlfriend last night and she was, like, ‘You know, people don’t really like zoos.…’” he said. “I’d been thinking about a metaphorical thing. Breaking: Cider-Braised Sausage and Lentils

📅 16 Oct 2026 | ⏱️ 2 min read (429 words, 📖 Standard) | Source: Epicurious

⏱️ ~2 mins left to finish
📖 0% read
💡 Key Takeaways
  • Sources indicate that I haven’t made a meal in the French countryside in fall; but sometimes I dream, and these slow-cooked lentils are what I’d make in such a situation.
  • More great fall recipes this way: Charred Cabbage With Sausages and Apples; Pork Chops With Green Chiles and Apples; Mustardy Cider-Braised Pork Chops.
  • extra-virgin olive oil in a large high-sided skillet or a medium heavy pot over medium-high.
📑 Quick Jump: 1. Overview • 2. Key Details • 3. Closing Notes

Sources indicate that I haven’t made a meal in the French countryside in fall; but sometimes I dream, and these slow-cooked lentils are what I’d make in such a situation. Back in my American reality, it still makes an excellent dinner or hearty weekend lunch. Look for mild smoked Austrian or German sausages, which lean on mellow herbs and warm spices (sometimes, if you’re lucky, they’re also stuffed with a nutty cheese)—this style is already cooked to a safe temperature, but the casing’s texture is greatly improved when seared before reheating. If your shop only carries sweet Italian sausage or something like an apple-stuffed chicken sausage, both work in a pinch. What a treat it will be to actually finish off that gallon of apple cider you impulsively bought last week in the lentil-braising liquid.

More great fall recipes this way: Charred Cabbage With Sausages and Apples; Pork Chops With Green Chiles and Apples; Mustardy Cider-Braised Pork Chops.

Heat 2 Tbsp. extra-virgin olive oil in a large high-sided skillet or a medium heavy pot over medium-high. Cook 6–8 smoked Austrian or German sausages (1–1½ lb.), turning often, until deeply browned on all sides, about 4 minutes. Transfer to a plate.

Combine 1 large red or yellow onion, finely chopped, 3 celery stalks, finely chopped, 1 large carrot, peeled, finely chopped, 1 tsp. freshly ground pepper, and ½ tsp. Diamond Crystal or ¼ tsp. Morton kosher salt, and remaining 2 Tbsp. extra-virgin olive oil in same pan. Reduce heat to medium and cook, stirring often and scraping up any browned bits stuck to bottom of pan, until vegetables are softened, 6–8 minutes. Add 5 garlic cloves, thinly sliced, and cook, stirring, just until fragrant, about 1 minute.

Add 2 cups low-sodium chicken or vegetable broth, 1½ cups apple cider, 1½ cups French green lentils, picked through, rinsed, ½ cup finely chopped parsley, 3 Tbsp. Dijon or whole grain mustard, and remaining ½ tsp. Diamond Crystal or ¼ tsp. Morton kosher salt to pan. Increase heat to high and bring to a boil. Cook until liquid is slightly reduced, about 5 minutes. Cover pan, reduce heat to medium-low, and cook until lentils are tender and most of the liquid is absorbed but mixture is still saucy, 30–35 minutes.

Industry observers note that uncover pan and stir in 1 Tbsp. apple cider vinegar or red wine vinegar. Nestle sausages into lentil mixture and add any juices pooled on plate. Simmer until sausages are warmed through, about 5 minutes. Top with parsley leaves and reserved celery leaves to serve.

#77471. Why You Should Never Put Frozen Meat In A Slow Cooker, According To Experts

Why You Should Never Put Frozen Meat In A Slow Cooker, According To Experts

📅 18 Nov 2026 | ⏱️ 4 min read (781 words, 📚 Deep Dive) | Source: Delish

⏱️ ~4 mins left to finish
📖 0% read
💡 Key Takeaways
  • Recent findings suggest that with busy schedules and limited time each day, slow cookers are key to getting dinner on the table.
  • Sources indicate that but think again.
  • Industry observers note that sorry to be the bearer of bad news: You should never put frozen meat directly into your slow cooker.
📑 Quick Jump: 1. Overview • 2. Key Details • 3. Closing Notes

Recent findings suggest that with busy schedules and limited time each day, slow cookers are key to getting dinner on the table. They can take simple ingredients and transform them into a complete, ready-to-eat meal. Because the slow cooker does all the work for you, you may think that it can also handle defrosting meat.

Sources indicate that but think again. The idea seems convenient in theory, but in practice, it raises some serious food safety concerns. We consulted health experts to learn more about adding frozen meat to a slow cooker. So next time you initiative a hands-off dinner, you can make sure your food is delicious and safe to eat.

Industry observers note that sorry to be the bearer of bad news: You should never put frozen meat directly into your slow cooker. “I am all for cutting out unnecessary steps in cooking, but using frozen meat in your slow cooker is not one of them,” notes Melissa Koch, RD, MEd.

According to recent reports, raw meat can carry harmful bacteria that cause foodborne illness. Freezing stops them from multiplying, but doesn't necessarily kill them. And because slow cookers heat food gradually, frozen meat can spend too long in what food safety experts call the “temperature danger zone.”.

According to recent reports, “The danger zone refers to a temperature range of 40°F (4°C) to 140°F (60°C) over two or more hours when harmful bacteria grow or multiply at a fast rate,” Koch explains. It can take hours for food in a slow cooker to move above the danger zone—and starting with frozen meat delays that process even further.

Sources indicate that “The appliance heats food slowly, and starting with frozen meat means the internal temperature may sit in the ‘danger zone’ for too long,” says chef and dietitian Sharniquia White. “This gives bacteria like Salmonella or E. coli more opportunity to multiply before the food reaches a safe cooking temperature.”.

What happens after eating food that has sat in the danger zone? The consequences vary based on your immune system, the extent of the contamination, and the strains of bacteria present. But none are pleasant, and some may even send you to the hospital.

Industry observers note that “Symptoms of food-borne illness can include nausea, vomiting, stomach cramps, and fever,” Koch says. “You can experience the effects of food-borne illness within a few minutes to days after consuming a load of harmful pathogens or bacteria.”.

Cooking frozen meat on the “low” setting of your slow cooker increases the time it spends in the danger zone, but the risk is present regardless. “The 'high' setting reduces the amount of time food spends at unsafe temperatures, but still doesn’t fully eliminate the risk when starting with frozen meat,” claims White.

Recent findings suggest that the ingredients you're using can also increase your risk. “Larger, denser cuts (like roasts or whole poultry) take longer to thaw and heat evenly, so they pose a greater risk of staying at unsafe temperatures for extended periods,” White explains.

Sources indicate that smaller pieces may thaw faster, but that doesn't necessarily make them safe to cook from frozen. White explains that ground meat is “particularly risky” because of the way it's processed, so it should be cooked thoroughly.

“I feed three young children at my home, so in my opinion, I wouldn't chance cooking frozen meat, no matter the size, in a slow cooker,” Koch indicates.

The answer is simple: thaw your meat before turning on your slow cooker. But your ideal method depends on how much time you have.

The safest, easiest, and least involved thawing method is to put your frozen meat in the fridge. The cold temperature of your refrigerator lets your food defrost gently without entering the danger zone.

According to recent reports, our editors recommend placing the meat on a plate or baking sheet to collect any juices and avoid contaminating other food in your fridge. This process can take anywhere from a couple of hours to a couple of days, depending on the cut of meat. “This requires some thought and effort, but in the long run it's worth your safety,” Koch says.

No time for that? No problem. You can thaw meat faster by submerging it in cold water in a leakproof bag, changing the water every 30 minutes, or defrosting it in the microwave, though the latter can compromise the meat's texture. Both methods require cooking the meat immediately afterward. “Once thawed, meat should go directly into the slow cooker,” White explains.

It all takes a little extra effort and planning, but it's worth it to avoid getting sick from your slow cooker dinner.

⏱️ ~10 mins left to finish
📖 0% read
💡 Key Takeaways
  • 7, 2024, Lana Del Rey officially debuted her relationship with Jeremy Dufrene, bringing him as her plus one to the wedding of model Karen Elson and Lee Foster in Upcoming York City.
  • Del Rey was also wearing a satin blue halter dress with white ballet flats while Dufrene wore a blue suit with a white button-up shirt and brown shoes.
  • 26, 2024, People reported that the couple obtained a marriage certificate.
📑 Quick Jump: 1. Overview • 2. Key Details • 3. Closing Notes

On Saturday, Sept. 7, 2024, Lana Del Rey officially debuted her relationship with Jeremy Dufrene, bringing him as her plus one to the wedding of model Karen Elson and Lee Foster in Upcoming York City. The couple walked out of Electric Lady Studios hand-in-hand wearing big smiles.

Del Rey was also wearing a satin blue halter dress with white ballet flats while Dufrene wore a blue suit with a white button-up shirt and brown shoes.

Weeks later, they got married. On Sept. 26, 2024, People reported that the couple obtained a marriage certificate. They had their ceremony that same day. Here’s everything to know about Jeremy Dufrene, Del Rey’s husband.

Industry observers note that dufrene operates as a captain for a tour boat company in Des Allemands, Louisiana, close to Fresh Orleans, called Airboat Tours by Arthur. The tours focus on local wildlife and apparently the company has a good reputation. In his bio, Dufrene indicates he once worked at a chemical plant and enjoys shrimping.

“After a little convincing by his family, he got his captain’s license and started running tours,” it continues.

According to People, Dufrene has three children, a son and two daughters.

In a recent development, del Rey made an appearance in one of Dufrene’s social media posts in 2019 after taking a tour of his while visiting for the BUKU Music + Art Project festival. In a now private post on Instagram, Dufrene wrote, “I never know who I can run across on my tours but always a pleasure @lanadelrey.”.

She also shared shots of him in Facebook posts, captioning them, “Jeremy lemme be captain at Arthur’s Air Boat Tours.”.

In a recent development, in May 2024, Del Rey reportedly took another tour. She tagged him in the caption of a photo with friends.

In August 2024, they were spotted at Reading & Leeds Festival and were seen in a video on TikTok holding hands. They then headed to London for a visit to Harrod’s and a local pub. After the images circulated, Del Rey denied she and Dufrene were dating in a comment on TikTok, simply writing “No,” on a video about their alleged relationship. It ended up later being a yes.

Recent findings suggest that people reported on Sept. 26, 2024, that the couple obtained a marriage license from the Lafourche Parish Clerk of Court on September 23. They had 30 days from that date to tie the knot.

The same day as People broke the news, Del Rey and Dufrene got married in Des Allemandes, Louisiana. They had their ceremony at the bayou where Dufrene works. Photos surfaced of Del Rey walking with her father there, wearing a ruffle neckline gown with a full skirt. She had a blue ribbon tied in her hair, which was styled in a side ponytail.

Another source told People that the couple chose a place close to their hearts for the ceremony.

In a recent development, “The wedding ceremony and reception were both held in the same bayou where Jeremy operates his swamp boats tours,” remarked the insider. “This is where they first met. It’s a special place for them. It was a beautiful, relaxed and family-focused wedding. The focus was just on their love story.”.

The source shared more about their love story, saying that Del Rey and Dufrene “initially met a few years ago the first time and then reconnected earlier this year.”.

They added, “It’s been kind of a whirlwind romance, but Lana’s close friends hoped she would get married. Jeremy is different from the men that Lana meets in the entertainment world. He’s a great guy. He’s charming and charismatic in a Southern way, very much a gentleman and he treats Lana really well. She’s an old soul.”.

Del Rey reportedly found her dress for the ceremony at a local boutique, Vintage Market by Trashy Diva, in New Orleans, and purchased it that May—months before she went public with her and Dufrene’s relationship.

A source told TMZ that it’s “unclear whether Lana strolled into the store specifically hunting for a wedding dress, but after trying on a bunch of other stuff, she ended up falling for the dress she spotted in the window.”.

The insider didn’t know the price, but they estimated that $400 is the “typical price range for wedding dresses at the store, which features curated styles from the 1920s to Y2K.”.

On October 25, Del Rey attended the InStyle Imagemaker Awards and was asked about her marriage for the first time publicly.

She simply replied, “It’s good. We’re happy.”.

On Saturday, December 7, Del Rey attended Variety’s Hitmakers Brunch and spoke in honor of producer Jack Antonoff as he was named Producer of the Decade. During her speech, Del Rey opened up about her husband and how Antonoff’s relationship with his then-wife, Margaret Qualley, inspired her to connect with Dufrene.

It has been revealed that “Most of all, I’m grateful for him for his example that he gave me in his marriage to Margaret,” the singer remarked, after thanking him for his work on her music. “I saw the way he looked at her when he met her, and he’s a big reason why I waited so long to get married and why I met my amazing husband.”.

She also admitted that having a high-profile career can make finding an authentic partner difficult.

According to recent reports, “I really feel like there’s kind of a singer’s curse around meeting an honest partner who has no skin in the game, no dog in the race,” she remarked. “And it’s super nerve-racking to have to hold onto an innocent perception of how things could go when you’re in an industry where maybe your values or your morals don’t quite match up with what’s going on.”.

Del Rey added, “Especially when people think that you probably don’t have any morals or values.”.

She then thanked Antonoff for “maybe helping other people look at me in a way that is a little bit closer to how I perceive myself.”.

In a carousel of pictures posted on April 4, the singer revealed some intimate moments with Dufrene. She was also celebrating upcoming highlights at Stagecoach music festival. In the caption, she wrote, “This has been such a crazy nine months and I’m so blessed that come the 25th, It will have been a year since I got to headline Coachella. Thank you to my buddies over there at the festival for letting me play my newly introduced songs this year for you—and to my amazing band helping me kick things off with rehearsals this week.”.

Sources indicate that the carousel included a picture from a birthday party where she and Dufrene are wearing matching tiaras, as well as the crocodile-themed birthday cake referencing Dufrene’s business. There was also a sweet photo of Dufrene embracing Del Rey from behind.

The couple seemed to be enjoying New York City in early spring and summer, based on a few posts from Del Rey. On May 7, she tagged Dufrene in a few clips and photos from a jazz club, writing they brought “a little taste of New Orleans” to the city.

On June 8, she shared a carousel of photos, many taken in Fresh York City, including a mirror selfie with a bunch of friends where it looks like Dufrene is standing behind her.

In a recent development, during her tour stop in Cardiff, Wales, on June 23, Del Rey made her affection for Dufrene very public. While performing “Stars Fell on Alabama,” she briefly stepped to the side of the stage to kiss her husband. After the moment of PDA, she returned to the mic and resumed singing.

According to recent reports, on July 31, 2025, Del Rey offered a rare glimpse of her and Dufrene’s private September 2024 wedding. She posted a photo from the ceremony on Instagram, featuring herself in a flowy white gown with a bow in her hair as she held hands with Dufrene, who wore a black suit.

Recent findings suggest that on September 26, Del Rey posted a carousel of images from her wedding to celebrate their anniversary. She included shots with Dufrene posing on an airboat and with friends and family, including Jack Antonoff and Margaret Qualley.

On October 5, Del Rey and Dufrene stepped out together for Valentino’s Paris Fashion Week runway show, marking one of their few public appearances since getting married. The couple arrived holding hands, with Del Rey wearing a lilac floor-length gown accented with a bow at the waist, while Dufrene opted for a navy jacket and matching trousers with tan boots.

Inside the event, the pair shared a kiss from their front-row seats.

Del Rey brought Dufrene as her date to the Ralph Lauren fashion show on Feb. 10, 2026. In a sweet photo from the event, she smiled happily while hanging onto her husband’s arm.

On February 17, Del Rey posted a series of Instagram Stories tied to the release of her newly introduced single, “White Feather Hawk Tail Deer Hunter.” One clip opened with footage from a cartoon, before cutting to a video of Del Rey and Dufrene dancing as the song played.

In the clip, she wore a brown sweater and an ivory skirt while Dufrene stood behind her in a khaki jacket. Del Rey released “White Feather Hawk Tail Deer Hunter” in full that day, tagging Dufrene in the announcement post as a co-writer on the track.

On March 27, Del Rey posted upcoming pictures with Dufrene from their life together, including a trip to Home Depot, time on his boat, and flipping through wedding book memories. In the caption, she wrote, “Happy birthday week to the sweetest guy I know ❤️🦆”.

Sources indicate that the couple was spotted in Los Angeles on April 17, enjoying a lunch date at The Ivy restaurant. Del Rey was wearing a striped shirt under an off-the-shoulder sweatshirt with denim shorts and ballet shoes. Dufrene was in a white T-shirt, khakis, and a black baseball hat. They appeared to have been out shopping. Del Rey carried her leather purse, and Dufrene had a shopping bag.

On August 27, Del Rey and Dufrene were photographed on a shopping trip in Los Angeles, where they stopped by a Ralph Lauren store.

Sources indicate that del Rey wore a white tank top with straight-leg jeans and an open light-wash denim shirt, finishing her look with white sneakers. Dufrene kept things casual in a gray T-shirt, black shorts, sneakers, a camouflage baseball cap, and sunglasses.

On September 27, Del Rey celebrated two years of marriage to Dufrene with an Instagram carousel featuring memories from their relationship, including footage of the couple kissing during their wedding ceremony.

“Hi husband, happy second anniversary... Thank you for making everywhere I’ve ever lived feel like home again. And also to our lil fam...literally everything we do is the best. Xo,” she wrote.

According to recent reports, dufrene shared his own anniversary tribute, writing, “Happy Anniversary to the most Beautiful and Precious lil wife. I love you so much.”.

Sources indicate that on November 20, Del Rey shared a series of photos from a Grand Theft Auto VI launch party in Miami, where she was joined by her husband. “Cruisin,” she captioned the Instagram carousel, which included photos of the couple posing together at the event.

Sources indicate that for the occasion, Del Rey carried a custom pink Hermès Birkin inspired by the video game and created by Privé Porter. The bag featured Swarovski-crystal designs referencing Vice City, the fictional Miami-inspired setting of the game. Del Rey also has a song, “Crazy for You,” on the Grand Theft Auto VI soundtrack, and she and Dufrene reportedly voice fictional radio hosts in the game.

31 Cranberry Recipes for Thanksgiving and Beyond

📅 12 Nov 2015 | ⏱️ 5 min read (1090 words, 📚 Deep Dive) | Source: Bonappetit

⏱️ ~5 mins left to finish
📖 0% read
💡 Key Takeaways
  • Look for firm, glossy cranberries and discard any that are soft, shriveled, or bruised.
  • Industry observers note that keep unwashed cranberries in their original bag in the refrigerator for up to four weeks, though they’re best used sooner.
  • Sources indicate that that vivid magenta filling is no food-coloring trick: Cranberries and plenty of lime give the curd its electric hue and tang.
📑 Quick Jump: 1. Overview • 2. Key Details • 3. Closing Notes

How to buy and store fresh cranberries.

Look for firm, glossy cranberries and discard any that are soft, shriveled, or bruised. A few pale pink berries are nothing to worry about.

Industry observers note that keep unwashed cranberries in their original bag in the refrigerator for up to four weeks, though they’re best used sooner. To stock up, freeze them in their original packaging or spread clean thoroughly dried berries on a baking sheet until frozen, then transfer to a freezer bag. They’ll keep their quality for up to a year. Many cooked cranberry recipes work with frozen berries straight from the freezer; check the recipe before thawing.

Sources indicate that that vivid magenta filling is no food-coloring trick: Cranberries and plenty of lime give the curd its electric hue and tang. Let the pie set overnight, then pile on billowy meringue and break out the kitchen torch.

In a recent development, A 12-oz. bag of cranberries, sugar, orange zest, and about 10 minutes at the stove are all you need for this tangy Thanksgiving essential. Make it up to five days ahead and save any leftovers for turkey-cranberry sliders.

Layers of tender buttermilk cake, tart cranberry jam, and silky white chocolate frosting make an excellent argument for serving cake on Thanksgiving. The sugared cranberries on top are like little sour candies.

Imagine Key lime pie dressed for the holidays. The punchy cranberry-lime curd meets a crisp press-in crust made with gingersnaps and pecans. A generous dollop of whipped cream rounds out the tartness.

Sources indicate that here’s a reason to keep canned cranberry sauce around after Thanksgiving. Jellied sauce melts into a glossy, sweet-and-sour glaze that coats chicken and green beans. Think orange chicken, with a cranberry twist.

Cranberries turn this classic upside-down apple tart a beautiful rosy pink while cutting through its buttery sweetness. Homemade rough puff pastry supplies the flaky base; vanilla ice cream is very much encouraged.

Sources indicate that canned whole-berry cranberry sauce becomes a punchy dressing for pleasantly bitter endive and frisée. Add crunchy candied pecans and salty Manchego, and suddenly cranberry sauce is doing salad duty.

Two layers of buttery, crumbly walnut crust surround a tart cranberry filling in this striking take on a Linzer torte. Save it for a holiday dessert table—or any occasion that calls for something special.

Sources indicate that dress crisp-bottomed Persian rice with dried cranberries, saffron, and fragrant herbs. The berries plump in ghee alongside rosemary, sage, and thyme, adding little pops of sweetness against the savory rice.

If the wobble is the best part of canned cranberry sauce for you, this homemade version delivers. It’s sliceable, deeply fruity, and subtly fragrant with cardamom and bay leaves. Bring on the ridges.

In a recent development, roasted brussels sprouts get a lively companion in cranberry mostarda, a sweet-tart condiment with mustard seeds, prunes, and a little brandy. Make extra mostarda: It belongs on more than just sprouts.

A warm cranberry-apple topping brings plenty of tart fruit flavor to this crowd-friendly baked oatmeal. It’s a welcome breakfast when the house is full and everyone seems to wake up hungry at once.

According to recent reports, rum, hard cider, cranberry juice, ginger ale, and lime make a lively batch cocktail. Cranberry-studded ice cubes do double duty, keeping glasses cold and making the punch look party-ready.

Jalapeño and lime give classic cranberry sauce a bright, spicy kick. It’s especially good alongside roasted meats or piled onto a leftover turkey sandwich when you want something with a little heat.

Sources indicate that forget the giant roast bird for a minute. These tender, gravy-coated turkey meatballs come with a cranberry-orange marmalade jam that stands in for traditional lingonberries. A heap of mashed potatoes completes the picture.

It has been revealed that fresh ginger gives this cranberry relish some zip, while golden raisins and allspice round out its tartness. Spoon it onto a cheese board or save the leftovers for French toast the next morning.

Herbs in the dredge give this crunchy fried chicken Thanksgiving energy, but the quick cranberry-mustard dipping sauce is the real holiday flourish. It’s a compelling alternative to roasting an entire turkey.

According to recent reports, homemade cranberry-thyme syrup, Campari, and Champagne make a sparkling cocktail that’s fruity, pleasantly bitter, and dressed for a party. Make the syrup up to two weeks ahead; the drinks come together in minutes.

Boxed stuffing mix gets a serious upgrade with aromatic vegetables, dried cranberries, and the savory drippings from crisp-skinned chicken thighs. It’s Thanksgiving-adjacent comfort food, made in one skillet any night of the week.

Roasted sweet potatoes and delicata squash get a glossy, sweet-and-sour cranberry sauce made with red wine vinegar and thyme. Make extra: The agrodolce is just as good spooned over Thanksgiving turkey.

According to recent reports, whole orange and a cinnamon stick give this chunky cranberry sauce its fragrant warmth. Blanching the chopped orange first keeps bitterness in check, while a little butter softens the berries’ sharp edge.

Sources indicate that A buttery, lemony custard studded with tart cranberries gives this Southern classic a holiday spin. The berries stay mostly intact, offering juicy little bursts of tartness against the rich filling.

Sources indicate that dried figs bring earthy sweetness to this bold cranberry chutney, while ginger, vinegar, and whole grain mustard keep it lively. It’s the sort of condiment you’ll want beside roast pork as much as turkey.

In a recent development, dorie Greenspan’s warmly spiced Bundt packs in fresh and dried cranberries, toasted almonds, and a little five-spice powder. Greek yogurt keeps the cake rich; orange icing supplies the finishing flourish.

Recent findings suggest that baker Amanda Mack tucks a tart cranberry-orange filling into exceptionally flaky buttermilk pastry for individual pies. They’re a thoughtful addition to a dessert spread where everyone wants to try a little of everything.

No simmering required for this bright, crunchy cranberry relish. Walnuts, shallot, mustard seeds, and Fresno chile give it plenty of texture and bite—a particularly good counterpoint to rich holiday mains.

Industry observers note that homemade cranberry-orange jam gives this tequila cocktail its fruity punch. Lime juice keeps it lively, while a sugar-salt-and-five-spice rim makes each glass taste decidedly more festive than a typical margarita.

Chopped fresh cranberries bring little bursts of tartness to an otherwise classic cheddar grilled cheese. A swipe of Dijon mustard ties the flavors together. Sometimes the best cranberry recipe is also lunch.

Have part of a bag left over? These ideas from the BA archives put even a small quantity to good use.

Exclusive: Shohei Ohtani Just Signed a Historic Deal With Newly introduced Balance

📅 20 Nov 2026 | ⏱️ 5 min read (1043 words, 📚 Deep Dive) | Source: Gq

⏱️ ~5 mins left to finish
📖 0% read
💡 Key Takeaways
  • Recent findings suggest that shohei Ohtani is used to making history.
  • Now, the 32-year-old Japanese icon is adding to those accolades with a pioneering endorsement deal, officially extending his relationship with his longtime partner New Balance through to the end of his baseball career.
  • “There’s a lot of trust,” Ohtani tells me through an interpreter during a sit-down in Boston of his decision to commit to the Fresh England sportswear stalwart for the long haul.
📑 Quick Jump: 1. Overview • 2. Key Details • 3. Closing Notes

Recent findings suggest that shohei Ohtani is used to making history. In addition to his four MLB MVP awards and two World Series rings, the Los Angeles Dodgers two-way great is the first member of the 50/50 club (having racked up 54 home runs and 59 stolen bases during the 2024 season), became the first player to hit three homers and record 10 strikeouts in a single game (which he managed in a 2025 NLCS contest against the Brewers), and earlier this year maintained simultaneous streaks in games on base (48) and innings without an earned run (32 and two-thirds).

Now, the 32-year-old Japanese icon is adding to those accolades with a pioneering endorsement deal, officially extending his relationship with his longtime partner New Balance through to the end of his baseball career. (While a rarefied group of athletes have signed lifetime sponsorship deals—including LeBron James and Cristiano Ronaldo at Nike, and Damian Lillard at Adidas—Ohtani’s new contract appears to be both the first to exclusively cover a star’s playing days and the first of its kind in MLB.).

“There’s a lot of trust,” Ohtani tells me through an interpreter during a sit-down in Boston of his decision to commit to the Fresh England sportswear stalwart for the long haul. “We’ve obviously built friendships, as well. They’ve been able to accommodate my requests, the things I’ve asked for, and, like I noted, that takes the involvement of a lot of trust. That relationship has been very, very good and smooth. I had no reservations about extending our relationship.”.

Sources indicate that earlier in the day, I shadowed Ohtani at New Balance’s headquarters, where, as part of the agreement, the company is renaming its on-site think tank as the Shohei Ohtani Sports Research Lab. A team of specialists led the Dodgers superstar through a slew of shoes—including his on-field Ohtani 1 model, which will receive new editions in 2027—and then a rack of branded apparel. All of it falls under his Shohei Ohtani Signature Collection, which New Balance launched in 2024 (about a year and a half after the athlete first signed with the company). The collection has grown deliberately and unhurriedly ever since—mirroring his patience in the batter’s box; Ohtani is methodical when it comes to product development and uninterested in rolling out rushed goods with his name slapped on them.

Sources indicate that while conducting a kind of footwear postmortem on his 2026 season—which started well, but ended with a rare slump (and left knee and right biceps injuries that kept him from pitching after July 3)—Ohtani noted there’d been some moments of slippage on the heel of his landing foot when pitching. On a printed-out diagram, he used a pencil to sketch ways in which the shoe’s spikes might be slightly reconfigured to find a sweet spot for stability on the mound and speed around the bases. The question of switching footwear between pitching and batting comes up, but Ohtani has not yet done this (and it seems the consensus is to stick with one shoe only).

“I have a lot of direct input into the footwear and apparel,” Ohtani notes. “That includes my style, which I like to keep simple, as well as performance-based requests, [like with my] spikes. Some years we make minor changes, and sometimes we’ll make a significant change. They understand what I want.”.

It has been revealed that ohtani’s apparel line runs across three categories: performance, lifestyle, and fanwear. His custom logo—a striking ink drawing of his figure, designed by the Japanese manga artist Takehiko Inoue—is featured subtly on the bulk of the lineup. “Shohei doesn’t see himself as a glamorous player,” Chris Davis, New Balance brand president and chief marketing officer, tells me. “He sees himself as a gritty, hardworking athlete who wants to get better every day, and his logo reflects this—it has this kind of quiet intensity.”.

While some of the future apparel designs boast cool technical features—like detachable, two-in-one, and reversible elements inspired by Ohtani’s two-way play—the man himself is only concerned that his products “fit comfortably and to be easy to wear.” When asked if there’s anyone whose style he likes or is influenced by, Ohtani shrugs. “Honestly, not really. I just like to wear what I like to wear.”.

It has been revealed that “[Shohei] is very quick and clear with his input,” claims Masahiro Uchida, Fresh Balance’s general manager of athlete signature product, who has worked alongside Ohtani for years. “On the performance side, he always prefers softness and a soft hand feel. For the lifestyle side, he prefers clean and simple. He also understands the occasion. He always asks us, ‘Where would I wear this?’” One major goal for Ohtani with his apparel, Uchida adds, is to “support the expansion of baseball culture and show his respect for its heritage. He is a super geek about MLB. He knows so much.”.

At 32, the duration of Ohtani’s career—and, now, his New Balance deal—remains an open question. That age can be considered as getting toward the older end in pro baseball, but elite pitchers have a habit of playing well into their 40s—Justin Verlander, for example, just pitched his final season at 43.

Ohtani still prepares on being a full two-way player in 2027, with hopes for a Cy Young Award—MLB’s top pitching honor, one of the few laurels he has yet to win—still alive. When the Dodgers’ season ended on October 15, Ohtani told the press that he was “not quite satisfied with how things shaped up on the pitching side.”.

What words of advice or motivation does he have, I ask, for the legion of kids hoping to follow in his footsteps? His answer feels like something he might be saying to himself as the next season approaches.

“If you want to become successful, baseball is a sport that takes a lot of repetitive practice,” he says. “You always have to work on your fundamentals. Once you reach a certain level, the sport becomes very, very hard. At that point, you need to remember why you’re playing. Are you playing because you love the sport? If you have that drive, that love for it, then even when it’s tough, you can overcome it.”.
